skill_name: Describe how an Agile approach was beneficial for a software project.
workflow: An Agile approach to software development promotes continual adaptation to changing requirements and project goals, allowing teams to achieve better outcomes and reduce time-to-market. Teams work in short sprints, focusing on a set of features, while using continuous feedback loops to understand customer needs and make changes quickly.
